title: Self Publish, Be Happy
one_sentence: International photobook platform and community focused on self-published photography, books, workshops, and artist visibility.
why_this_fits_short: Strong fit for an artist whose work can live as quiet photobook or zine sequences rather than conventional gallery proposals.
quick_action: Research current submission, workshop, and publication opportunities; identify whether portfolio review or newsletter visibility is available.
three_bullets: Strong international photobook credibility.
Good fit for quiet image sequences and artist-book thinking.
More strategic than a one-off local wall show if publication is the goal.

title: The Photographers' Gallery
one_sentence: Major photography institution with exhibitions, bookshop, talks, and international visibility.
why_this_fits_short: Likely difficult, but valuable as a benchmark institution and possible source of open calls, bookshop leads, talks, and artist references.
quick_action: Do not pitch cold immediately; research shop, events, open calls, and comparable artists first.
three_bullets: High prestige and strong photography alignment.
Better used as research target or long-term relationship target.
Can reveal peer artists and publication pathways.

title: PhotoVogue Open Calls
one_sentence: Global photography platform associated with Vogue, with periodic open calls and artist visibility opportunities.
why_this_fits_short: Useful for international exposure if her work can be framed as poetic documentary, memory, place, or contemporary visual storytelling.
quick_action: Check current open calls and archive previous selected projects to judge aesthetic fit.
three_bullets: Global visibility without requiring local gallery access.
Good for photographic storytelling and atmospheric image series.
Needs careful project framing, not casual upload.

title: LensCulture Awards / Open Calls
one_sentence: International photography platform with recurring awards, open calls, and portfolio visibility.
why_this_fits_short: Potentially useful if her strongest body of work can be shaped into a coherent photo series with a clear statement.
quick_action: Check current award themes, fees, previous winners, and whether the fee/reward balance is worth it.
three_bullets: Good global photography exposure, but competition is high.
Requires a coherent project statement and strong sequencing.
Fee/value ratio must be checked before recommending.

title: Printed Matter Art Book Fairs
one_sentence: Major international art-book nonprofit and fair organizer with strong relevance to artist books, zines, and printed matter.
why_this_fits_short: Highly relevant if her work develops into books, zines, calendars, or small editions; likely a long-term rather than immediate target.
quick_action: Research fair exhibitor criteria and identify comparable small publishers or artists first.
three_bullets: Top-tier printed matter relevance.
Strong long-term target for artist-book positioning.
Probably requires a stronger publication object before applying.

title: Offprint
one_sentence: International art publishing fair focused on independent, experimental, and artist-led publishing.
why_this_fits_short: Good fit if her atmospheric work is developed into printed matter, especially artist books or quiet photographic publications.
quick_action: Research exhibitor criteria, fees, and past participants before treating this as actionable.
three_bullets: Strong artist-book and independent publishing fit.
International credibility beyond local Tokyo opportunities.
Likely better after creating a clear publication object.

title: Center for Book Arts Opportunities
one_sentence: Book arts institution with exhibitions, residencies, education, and opportunities connected to artist books and printed matter.
why_this_fits_short: Potential fit if her work becomes more explicitly book-oriented or object/paper based.
quick_action: Check current opportunities, eligibility, and whether international artists may apply.
three_bullets: Useful bridge between visual art and book form.
May suit artist-book development more than standard gallery exposure.
Eligibility and location constraints need verification.

title: Aperture Portfolio Prize / Opportunities
one_sentence: Prestigious photography publisher and platform with periodic prizes, publishing, and portfolio opportunities.
why_this_fits_short: Very high-prestige but difficult; useful as a long-term benchmark and possible stretch opportunity.
quick_action: Research current open opportunities and compare her work to recent selected artists.
three_bullets: Major photography credibility.
High difficulty means it should not dominate easy-first strategy.
Best used as a stretch target after strong sequencing and statement.

title: Photobook Cafe
one_sentence: Independent London photobook space connected to photography books, events, and community.
why_this_fits_short: Potentially strong for a quiet photobook-oriented artist seeking community, visibility, and publication context.
quick_action: Research whether they accept consignments, events, submissions, or artist-book inquiries.
three_bullets: More intimate and approachable than major institutions.
Strong thematic alignment if she develops printed work.
Needs direct inquiry or consignment research.

title: Der Greif Open Calls
one_sentence: Contemporary photography platform and publication with open calls and themed visual storytelling opportunities.
why_this_fits_short: Potential fit for poetic, atmospheric photography if her work is sequenced around a strong theme.
quick_action: Check current calls, previous themes, selected artists, and submission fees.
three_bullets: Good contemporary photography context.
Requires conceptual framing and project clarity.
International visibility without immediate gallery logistics.
